title: Stop answers 409 in the gap after an idle session's last wait queued its resume but before that resume dispatched
outcome: From the round-2 review of w-f917452faa71 (Claude delegation-2c55b693, Low). Stop on an Idle session now consumes its pending delegation and test-run waits (src/session_stop_idle_wait.rs). There is a narrow window: the last wait settles and queues its Orchestrator resume prompt under the lock (refresh_delegation_waits_matching_locked / queue_delegation_wait_resume_locked), and the dispatch only runs after the lock is dropped (dispatch_delegation_wait_resumes). A Stop arriving in that window finds no pending wait, answers 409 SESSION_NOT_RUNNING, and the resume then dispatches. Fix direction (needs a decision, because workflow sessions also use Orchestrator queued prompts): either count an idle, unlatched session with a queued Orchestrator continuation as brakeable, or document the gap.
acceptance: Stop answers 409 in the gap after an idle session's last wait queued its resume but before that resume dispatched is done
